work.problem: Agents report in their own terms and drift from the Product Owner's intent; the canonical Communication Efficiency skill should require the Product Owner's established language, intent and authority (EEP #132).

findings.reason: The change doesn't touch the journal or its append-only enforcement.
No control-catch metric or attribution changes.
No Jira issue shape or parser contract changes; the skill names Scrum terms, not a tracker format.
No Builder or price-table contract changes.
No register or journal schema changes.
No vendor sync, contract pin or workflow changes; one skill document only.
No change to sync PR generation or its source name.
No autonomy promotion; the skill keeps agent claims distinct from verified results.
No change to the governance baseline or its controls.
The change is recorded under KAN-123 and claims no ticket or finding closed.

lessons: Change the one canonical skill; consumers move to it only through their pinned bindings.
Commit this record first, in its own commit, before the skill change: #132 failed the Kappa check without it.
uncertainty: A third KAN-123 record beside KAN-123.json and KAN-123-skills.json; the owner's decision on per-ticket record naming is still open.
The skill's effect on agent behavior is checked by the owner in use, not by a test.
